_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every quantitative claim in the equity-index paper; produced by equity/index/make_results.R (run headless from index/).

emissions.interpolation: per county and pollutant, piecewise linear (stats::approx) between the nearest available years 2020-2025; exact where 2022 exists

_meta.census: ACS 2022 5-year, cached in test/census_*.rds; not refetched

variants.published: as printed: legacy normaliser (n-2)/3, absent groups scored 0, old emissions
variants.fix_only: corrected index n/(2(n-1)), absent groups not scored, published emissions
variants.rerun: variant A (HEADLINE): corrected index, 2022 interpolated per county, piecewise linear (approx) between the nearest available CAT years 2020-2025 (62 counties); exact where 2022 exists
variants.rerun_endpoints: variant A-endpoints: corrected index, 2022 from the straight line between 2020 and 2025 only (the earlier method)
variants.exact_2020: variant B: corrected index, exact 2020 emissions (62)
variants.exact_2025: variant C: corrected index, exact 2025 emissions (62)
variants.exact_2022_38: variant D: corrected index, exact 2022 emissions, 38 of 62 counties (check only)

status_vocab.reported_in_manuscript: value currently printed in the submitted manuscript; recomputed here and equal after rounding
status_vocab.confirmed_by_tim: Tim has confirmed this value is correct
status_vocab.recomputed: recomputed from the underlying data this revision (evidence pointer says how)
status_vocab.TODO-tim: value needed from Tim before it can be stated in the manuscript
status_vocab.TODO-recompute: must be recomputed from the underlying data this revision
status_vocab.not_reproduced: the published method and data do not reproduce the printed value; printed value in note
